paper_title: Tell2Design A Dataset for Language-Guided Floor Plan Generation
caption: Number of floor plans vs. number of rooms per floor plan in the T2D dataset.
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the relationship between the number of floor plans and the number of rooms per floor plan within the T2D dataset. The horizontal axis represents the number of rooms, ranging from 4 to 8, with each value equally spaced. The vertical axis represents the number of floor plans, labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35000, with tick labels at intervals of 5000. There are four bars displayed, each representing a different number of rooms. The bar for 4 rooms has a height corresponding to an approximate value of 5788. The bar for 5 rooms has a height representing approximately 25104. The bar for 6 rooms reaches a height of roughly 20364. The bar for 7 rooms has a height of approximately 29278, representing the highest value of the bars. All bars are rendered in a uniform blue color and are sorted in ascending order of the number of rooms along the horizontal axis.
